_help: Team roles for the Desk. cli: claude | codex (or give a full argv). model: what that CLI's --model / -m takes. effort: claude --effort / codex model_reasoning_effort (low, medium, high). tools: Claude's built-in tools for the role (fewer tools = a smaller prompt on every call); omit for the default set. Claude roles skip MCP servers unless mcp is true. prompt: a file in roles/ added to the agent's system prompt. icon: an svg in icons/, without .svg; avatar: a png. worktree: true for roles that edit code; each gets its own git worktree. on_request: true for roles that start only when Kabeer asks (team start needs --requested; the Desk's buttons pass it). bin/team starts every role; roles/protocol.md is added to every role's prompt. fresh_at: context size in tokens past which the Desk suggests a fresh start (a role can set its own).
